title: Agent-scale Git separates authoritative storage from compute
subtitle: Decoupled repository storage and elastic workers let write pressure and read fan-out scale independently.

nodes.label: Coupled Git node
nodes.detail: Storage and compute scale together under human-paced traffic

nodes.label: Agent write pressure
nodes.detail: Concurrent pushes, branches, and refs stress the write path

nodes.label: CI read fan-out
nodes.detail: Automation multiplies repository reads after each change

nodes.label: Authoritative storage
nodes.detail: Durable repository data moves to independent blob storage

nodes.label: Elastic workers
nodes.detail: Lightweight compute and caches scale separately from durability

nodes.label: Protected refs
nodes.detail: Branch protection, review, and audit remain policy boundaries

callouts.label: Independent scaling
callouts.detail: Read, write, and compute capacity no longer move as one unit.

callouts.label: Durable authority
callouts.detail: Source-of-truth repository state is separated from disposable cache.

callouts.label: Human control
callouts.detail: Higher machine throughput does not remove review and protection.

footer: Agentic coding turns Git into a high-concurrency systems problem.
